observations: Inspected all nine pairs: gold face/curtain hand, repaired C12 seated face/folded hands, original summer joy, new summer laughter, first plea eyes/tears/mouth, exact final downcast face and cup/lap area.

Delivery mildly smooths hair strands, stubble and foliage texture; the mouth/eye expressions, tear highlights, pendant/earphone lines, hand silhouettes and cup outline remain legible. No conspicuous new block boundaries in inspected faces.

C12 already has soft small face/mouth lines in the accepted source/master. Compression retains that limitation; no claim of repairing it. The final hands are partly obscured behind the cup as in the source.

This scoped still comparison evaluates delivery compression, not a new source motion/anatomy gate. The complete master has independent full-film review. A representative first plea face is sampled here; all final frames also enter the full-film SSIM/decode check.
limits: Lossy picture derivative, not pixel-identical. Native still sampling does not replace temporal review or assert artifact-free every-frame perfection.
